tool_calls.text: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!target'"' | sort | sed -n '1,200p' && printf '%s\\n' '--- README ---' && sed -n '1,240p' README.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- pom ---' && sed -n '1,220p' pom.xml"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- application.yml ---' && sed -n '1,240p' src/main/resources/application.yml && printf '%s\\n' '--- controllers/services/security ---' && for f in src/main/java/com/example/accounts/{account/AccountController.java,account/AccountService.java,payment/PaymentController.java,payment/PaymentService.java,payment/PaymentDispatcher.java,payment/QueuedPaymentJob.java,closure/ClosureController.java,cases/CaseController.java,customer/AdminCustomerController.java,security/SecurityConfig.java,security/AccessPolicy.java,security/JwtClaimsConverter.java,web/ApiExceptionHandler.java}; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,280p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in src/main/java/com/example/accounts/integration/{scheme/HttpSchemeClient.java,scheme/SchemeProperties.java,fraud/HttpFraudScreeningClient.java,fraud/FraudProperties.java,ledger/HttpLedgerClient.java,ledger/LedgerProperties.java,notify/HttpNotificationClient.java,notify/NotificationProperties.java} src/main/java/com/example/accounts/AccountsApplication.java src/main/java/com/example/accounts/account/{Account.java,AccountRepository.java} src/main/java/com/example/accounts/payment/{Payment.java,PaymentRepository.java,PaymentRequest.java,PaymentStatus.java} src/main/java/com/example/accounts/closure/{ClosureRequest.java,ClosureRequestRepository.java}; do echo "### $f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- payment tests ---' && sed -n '1,260p' src/test/java/com/example/accounts/PaymentApiTest.java && printf '%s\\n' '--- application test support/integration fakes ---' && for f in src/test/java/com/example/accounts/support/{TestIntegrations.java,FakeScheme.java,FakeLedger.java,FakeNotifications.java}; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done && printf '"'%s\\n' '--- scheduled enablement/config references ---' && rg -n \"EnableScheduling|actuator|health|fraud|HELD|POSTING_FAILED|closure|@Scheduled|timeout|logging|tenant\" src/main src/test README.md"
/bin/bash -lc "test -s docs/fmea.md && sed -n '1,80p' docs/fmea.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- tail ---' && tail -30 docs/fmea.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---' && git status --short"
